newsitem.title: USA: LSI Logic shares plunge on third-quarter outlook.
newsitem.headline: LSI Logic shares plunge on third-quarter outlook.

text.p: LSI Logic Corp. shares plunged 13 percent Tuesday amid concerns that the computer chip maker's revenue growth could be less than expected in the September quarter.
Stock in LSI, based in Milpitas, Calif., fell $5.125 to $34 on New York Stock Exchange trading of 8.72 million shares, making it the second-most active issue on the Big Board.

The company, which makes custom chips and electronic components for other computer makers, is "being cautious regarding prospects" for the third quarter, Clark Westmont, an analyst at investment bank Montgomery Securities in San Francisco, wrote in a research report.
"We still expect LSI to deliver growth in the third quarter, but it may be lower than our prior expectations of a 9 percent increase from (the June quarter)," Westmont said.
LSI books its orders from customers a few months in advance, so its backlog should be in place by now, Westmont said. But the company is "cautious at this juncture."

Robert Sison, LSI's manager of investor relations, said the company has not released any new information. Company executives were not available for more comment because of business meetings abroad, Sison said.
LSI counts Cabletron Systems Inc., Intel Corp. and Seagate Technology Inc. as major customers -- all of which have warned in recent days that they face a slower-than-expected second quarter.
Westmont said he will keep his earnings forecasts for the September quarter unchanged until the June quarter results are released.
